description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions and types for interacting with XDP sockets via netlink, including serialization, deserialization, and querying socket information.

classes.name: xdpSocketRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for XDP socket information, with methods for serialization and length calculation.

classes.name: XDPSocket
classes.description: Represents an XDP socket, with a method to deserialize data into its fields.

classes.name: XDPDiagInfoResp
classes.description: Response structure containing XDP socket diagnostic information.

classes.name: XDPInfo
classes.description: Contains detailed information about an XDP socket, such as ring entries, UID, and stats.

classes.name: XDPDiagUmem
classes.description: Represents UMEM (user memory) associated with XDP sockets, with a deserialization method.

classes.name: XDPDiagStats
classes.description: Holds statistics related to XDP sockets, with a deserialization method.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an xdpSocketRequest into a byte slice.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the size of the xdpSocketRequest.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes byte data into an XDPSocket object.

methods.name: SocketXDPGetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about an XDP socket by inode and/or cookie.

methods.name: SocketDiagXDP
methods.description: Requests diagnostic info for all XDP sockets.

methods.name: socketDiagXDPExecutor
methods.description: Executes a function to process netlink messages related to XDP sockets.

methods.name: attrsToXDPDiagInfoResp
methods.description: Converts netlink route attributes into an XDPDiagInfoResp object.
